answer: A wharf authority can resist Sybils by issuing non-transferable work credits that only accrue through verified useful jobs. Each new agent starts at zero and must complete a sequence of checked tasks - data labeling, code review, delivery confirmation - before it can trade or vote. Credits decay if idle and cannot be bought or transferred, so one operator running many identities must redo the whole slow history for each one, like shale layers building up one at a time. A sudden spiral of fresh accounts has no weight until each has paid the same time and effort cost.
